question: From what point and to what height should the side space be constructed?
premises: The kapota support is the starting point.
The kakṣa is the element to be made.
Its height should match the nose height.
inference: One should construct the kakṣa from the kapota support up to the height of the nose.
uncertainties: The technical identification of kakṣa varies in architectural texts.
plain_english: From the kapota support, one should make the kakṣa as high as the nose.
